conversational-robotics/conversational-r.title: Conversational Robotics
conversational-robotics/conversational-r.description: This chapter explores conversational robotics, which encompasses the design and implementation of robots capable of natural, multimodal interaction with humans through spoken and written language. Conversational robotics builds on VLA systems to enable sophisticated human-robot interaction through natural language interfaces.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics textbook. This comprehensive guide covers the fundamental concepts, development techniques, and practical applications of physical artificial intelligence and humanoid robotics.

nvidia-isaac/nvidia-isaac-intro.title: NVIDIA Isaac Platform
nvidia-isaac/nvidia-isaac-intro.description: This chapter introduces the NVIDIA Isaac platform, a comprehensive solution for developing, simulating, and deploying AI-powered robots. The platform combines NVIDIA's GPU computing capabilities with specialized tools and frameworks for robotics applications.

robot-simulation/gazebo.title: Robot Simulation with Gazebo
robot-simulation/gazebo.description: This chapter covers the use of Gazebo, a powerful robotics simulator that provides accurate physics simulation, high-quality graphics, and convenient programmatic interfaces.

robot-simulation/unity.title: Robot Simulation with Unity
robot-simulation/unity.description: This chapter covers the use of Unity, a powerful game engine that has been adapted for robotics simulation, particularly for scenarios requiring high-fidelity graphics and complex environments.

ros2-fundamentals/ros2-concepts.title: Core ROS 2 Concepts
ros2-fundamentals/ros2-concepts.description: This section delves deeper into the fundamental concepts that make ROS 2 a powerful framework for robotics development.

ros2-fundamentals/ros2-examples.title: ROS 2 Examples and Best Practices
ros2-fundamentals/ros2-examples.description: This section provides practical examples of ROS 2 concepts and best practices for implementing them in humanoid robotics systems.

ros2-fundamentals/ros2-intro.title: ROS 2 Fundamentals
ros2-fundamentals/ros2-intro.description: This chapter introduces the Robot Operating System (ROS 2), the middleware framework that enables communication and coordination between different robotic components.

vla-systems/vla-systems-intro.title: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Systems
vla-systems/vla-systems-intro.description: This chapter covers Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, which represent a paradigm for embodied AI that integrates visual perception, language understanding, and action execution in a unified framework. These systems are crucial for humanoid robots that need to interact with humans and environments using natural language commands.

weekly-breakdowns/week-1.title: Week 1 - Introduction to Physical AI
weekly-breakdowns/week-1.description: This week introduces the foundational concepts of Physical AI and Embodied Intelligence that will underpin the rest of the textbook.

weekly-breakdowns/week-2.title: Week 2 - ROS 2 Fundamentals
weekly-breakdowns/week-2.description: This week focuses on the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), the middleware framework essential for robotics development.

weekly-breakdowns/week-3.title: Week 3 - Robot Simulation
weekly-breakdowns/week-3.description: This week focuses on robot simulation techniques using Gazebo and Unity, essential for testing and validating humanoid robotics algorithms.

weekly-breakdowns/week-4.title: Week 4 - NVIDIA Isaac Platform
weekly-breakdowns/week-4.description: This week focuses on the NVIDIA Isaac platform, which provides specialized tools and hardware acceleration for AI-powered robotics applications.

weekly-breakdowns/week-5.title: Week 5 - Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Systems
weekly-breakdowns/week-5.description: This week focuses on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, which integrate perception, language understanding, and motor control for advanced humanoid robotics.

weekly-breakdowns/week-6.title: Week 6 - Conversational Robotics
weekly-breakdowns/week-6.description: This week focuses on conversational robotics, which enables sophisticated human-robot interaction through natural language interfaces.
